svg.title: One chatbot turn
svg.desc: A local model sorts the question first; every intent except in-scope gets a fixed reply without the chatbot model, and a question the classifier can't sort goes on to the model. Otherwise the model calls tools in a loop of at most eight calls; its answer then passes an empty-answer check, a citation check (a quote mark the checks can't place counts as unretrieved evidence) and a figure check, and the citations it retrieved are numbered with their sources listed, before it is shown.
